title: protocol_events
description: GENERATED by scripts/codegen.ts from contracts/ — do not edit. Run `npm run gen`.

event_id.description: Deterministic UUID (version 8, hash-derived) identifying the event. Used for deduplication.

event_ts.description: When the event happened, Coordinated Universal Time (UTC), ISO 8601 with millisecond precision and a Z suffix.

customer_id.description: Quandong customer code. MFW = Murray Flats Water (fictional).

site_id.description: Pump station (PS01 to PS40) or HO for head office.

feed.description: Name of the feed this event belongs to.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the contract the event was produced against.

generator_run_id.description: Identifier of the generator deployment (seed and configuration) that produced the event.

asset_id.description: Target asset that received the command.

initiator_asset_id.description: Asset that sent the command, or null when the sender is not in the inventory.

initiator_ip.description: IPv4 address that sent the command.

function_code.description: Protocol function code (for example Modbus 3 = read holding registers, 6 = write single register, 90 = vendor programming function).

register_or_point.description: Register, point or tag addressed, e.g. 40021 (CL2.SETPOINT_MGL). Null for program and firmware operations.

old_value.description: Value before a write, when known.

new_value.description: Value written, when the operation is a write.

user_context.description: User or application context reported by the initiator (for example an HMI operator login), when available.

command_count.description: Number of identical commands aggregated into this row (1 for writes and programming).

result.description: Whether the target accepted the command.

logic_checksum_before.description: Logic checksum before a program download.

logic_checksum_after.description: Logic checksum after a program download.

firmware_version.description: Firmware version reported by the target at the time of the command.
